name: Star Dartle 2000
storyline:
A small group of rebels have revolted against the empire of Lord Shiptaur. The empire has sputtered
into a halt and the navy has been assembled. Lord Shiptaur has sent you, his trusty servant, to
eliminate the threat. Take out the rebels and save the empire from internal destruction.
summary:
Lord Shiptaur beckons you to destroy them all. This scrolling shooter challenges your reflexes and counting abilities.

One of the games included in 1999: Megallennium 6-in-1 Mega Cart.
